scripts.package: pnpm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --filename eda_browser_extension_firefox.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --filename eda_browser_extension_chromium.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/safari --filename eda_browser_extension_safari.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted && mv web-ext-artifacts/*.xpi web-ext-artifacts/eda_browser_extension.xpi
scripts.package:chromium: pnpm run build:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:safari: pnpm run build:safari && web-ext build --source-dir dist/safari --filename eda_browser_extension_safari.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:crx: pnpm run build:chromium && crx3 -o web-ext-artifacts/eda_browser_extension.crx -p key.pem dist/chromium
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
